title: Activity agents
responsibility: Shows declared agent activity while making stale, unavailable and unreadable registrations explicit.

inputs.name: ActivityAgents.agents
inputs.description: Required roster or null. Null means live activity is not available in this recorded history, not zero working agents. Roster supplies counts, tracking state and declared agent details.

inputs.name: ActivityAgents.sampledAt
inputs.description: Optional sample timestamp, empty by default. Supplies displayed UTC read time and freshness calculation.

inputs.name: ActivityAgents.reading
inputs.type: { now: number; failed: boolean; refresh: () => void }
inputs.description: Optional current clock, refresh-failure flag and refresh callback. When absent the view uses the sample time for freshness and offers no refresh button.

outputs.name: ActivityAgents
outputs.description: Working-agents card with current or Unknown count, stale/failed-read notices and registration guidance when tracking was never used. Lists agents with state, model, checkout, branch and details. Working agents expose task/loop and four unit chips initially; nonworking declarations stay behind a disclosure. Unreadable registrations are reported as uncounted.
